notes.title: Long-awaited update 1.3.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We just updated the game to the new version with the following improvements and fixes:

Fixing game crashes when the Windows username is not in Latin.
More correct initial choice of the user's language.
Selecting the language of the game from the game settings in Steam.
Added a cross promo for a new game in this series!

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Game Update available!
notes.notes: If you have the game in your Steam library the update will install automatically.
